verdict.rationale: Alloy documents a transaction-monitoring workflow use case that monitors transaction events in real time or on a schedule, applies policy logic, and raises alerts or investigations when thresholds are met. Events can also be routed to Source Workflows for evaluation. This covers configurable monitoring rules and thresholds, but nothing shows thresholds can differ by customer segment or how a compliance officer authors them. Missing for 10: segment-specific threshold configuration, documentation of the rule-authoring interface for compliance users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds

citations.quote: Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
any event can be submitted for additional monitoring by mapping the event type to a Source Workflow.
Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
